episode_summary: In this episode, Megan Walters shares her journey from a new agent to a top producer without buying leads or cold calling. She emphasizes the importance of building a personal brand, leveraging social media, and using innovative lead generation tactics. Megan also discusses time management strategies and her approach to real estate investment.
